from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        """
        Optimized workflow: coordinator-guided iterative exploration, then strict final formatting.
        """
        star = operator.StarWithCoordinator(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            coordinator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            worker_prompts=[
                prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_COORD_WORKER_GREEDY_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_COORD_WORKER_BLOCK_PROMPT,
                prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_COORD_WORKER_REPAIR_PROMPT,
            ],
            coordinator_prompt=prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_COORDINATOR_PROMPT,
            n_rounds=2,
        )
        draft = await star(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=2,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_FINALIZE_PROMPT, prompt_custom.CAR_PAINT_FORMAT_PROMPT],
        )
        solution = await seq(draft["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
